name: Installment accrual persists tenant-scoped liabilities
title: SC-10-01-03 Installment accrual persists tenant-scoped liabilities
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a capital project has an unaccrued installment for a site
When the site manager accrues that installment
Then the installment is marked accrued
And liabilities are created only for units in that site
